Return to Bill to view financial data stored on this device.
YOUR FINANCES STAY ON THIS DEVICE.
Bill declares no Internet permission. It does not upload notification text, screenshots, accounts, balances, or ledger data to a Bill server.
Three separate local tools, never one black-box permission

Notifications, read-only payment-result pages, and one-shot screenshots are separate opt-ins. The tile captures only after your tap; its bundled Chinese, English, and Japanese OCR runs on this phone with no server. Final APK and device validation is still in progress, it never proves a payment provider, and it never posts without your confirmation.

Ledger data stays on this device. You can use the Quick Settings tile for one offline screenshot, or share PNG/text and select a small text file for review. Dedicated Alipay, WeChat Pay, and bank capture still requires real redacted samples.
Each route is separate. This build does not ask you to enable a high-sensitivity permission before it has a verified use.

Not available yet: this build has no verified provider template, so Bill’s listener catalog is empty and it does not read notification text. A future verified route will require two separate choices: grant Bill notification access in Android Settings, then enable that route inside Bill. Do not enable notification access now.
Current status: no verified notification template. Bill is not reading notification text.

Not available yet: the separate observer has no active target app and no screen-text access. A verified source rule, energy test, and a separate opt-in are required before it can observe a result page. When available, Android Settings > Accessibility is the only place to enable it. It never clicks, scrolls, or screenshots.

Experimental on Android 11+: enable the dedicated accessibility service below, then add “Capture receipt” to Quick Settings. Each tap captures the current screen once and runs the bundled model locally; the picker can process up to five images one by one without whole-library permission. It reads no nodes, performs no clicks, and never watches in the background. Final APK and target-device validation is still in progress, so this is not a supported payment source. Android blocks secure windows; if the system permits a manual screenshot, share that PNG, otherwise enter the record manually.
